# `npx @sanity/cli blueprints stacks`

List remote Stacks for a project or organization. Use this read-only command to discover a Stack ID before running a targeted info, logs, config, deploy, promote, or destroy command.

## Run

List Stacks for the locally configured scope:

```sh
npx @sanity/cli blueprints stacks --json
```

Select a scope explicitly when working outside the local Blueprint:

```sh
npx @sanity/cli blueprints stacks --project-id PROJECT_ID --json
npx @sanity/cli blueprints stacks --organization-id ORGANIZATION_ID --json
```

The JSON result contains `stacks`, `scopeType`, and `scopeId`; each entry carries `resourceCount` rather than a full `resources` array. Zero results prints `No stacks found` and emits no JSON. Match both the Stack and its scope; names alone may be ambiguous.

To also include Stacks scoped to the organization's projects:

```sh
npx @sanity/cli blueprints stacks --organization-id ORGANIZATION_ID --include-projects --json
```

`--include-projects` requires `--organization-id`, cannot be combined with `--project-id`, and only queries the organization's first 50 projects. This command does not change the local Blueprint target; use `blueprints config --edit` for that.
